page_note: Page contains tail of preceding teaching on trees/enthumesis/painter (segs 0-9), then pivots via a substantive cosmological question on virgin/continent (segs 10-11), wrapped by a clear apostolic-dialogue frame (segs 12-13, 19-22) with an ecclesial marker ('the gathering of his church'). The Teacher's answer (segs 23-33) returns to substrate cosmology — the virgin = mystery of the Aeons of Greatness/sign of entire Light, the continent = mystery of the Light that descended, was mingled, defiled, and ascended. Apparent apostolic_dialogue density is inflated by the Q&A wrapper but the substantive cosmological content is dominant.
